title: Core: Renderer - motion tween interpolation
description: Unit tests for motion tween interpolation in the renderer. The engine should interpolate x, y, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, alpha between keyframes when tweenType='motion'. Create a scene with two keyframes (frame 0 and frame 9) containing a SymbolInstance at different positions, then call getInterpolatedFrame(scene, layerIdx, 4) (or equivalent) and verify the interpolated values are midway. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/tween-interp.test.ts.
